reason: A critical serialization bug remains: metrics can include Infinity/NaN, causing JSON parsing failures. Several minor logic/cleanliness issues also persist (duplicate prev_loc_mask_rate update, potential empty households, convergence window off-by-one, stockout counting semantics, and headless visualization robustness). With 3 iterations left, a focused pass can resolve these and stabilize outputs.

specific_areas: Make metrics JSON-safe: sanitize non-finite numbers and use json.dump(..., allow_nan=false)
Deduplicate and clean prev_loc_mask_rate update logic in step()
Guard against appending empty households in _build_entities()
Fix adoption_curve_convergence to compute diffs over the last window+1 points
Track stockout days with a per-day flag to count once if inventory hits zero at any time
Harden visualize() for headless environments (Agg backend and safe show/save)
Remove redundant pass statements that precede executable code
Add regression tests for metrics serialization (no NaN/Infinity) and convergence window correctness

task_understanding.adjustments: Treat JSON serialization compliance as a gating requirement. Prioritize fixes that unblock strict parsers over new features.

data_analysis.adjustments: Add a systematic scan for non-finite values (NaN/Infinity) in all metric trees before serialization; confirm edge cases like zero supply are covered.

model_planning.adjustments: Defer model complexity changes; focus on correctness and stability of current dynamics. Optional: plan for smoothing of observed norms later.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement a json_safe sanitizer; enforce allow_nan=false in all dumps/prints; remove duplicate prev_loc_mask_rate updates; guard household creation; fix convergence window; add per-day stockout flag; make visualize headless-safe; remove redundant pass statements.

code_verification.adjustments: Add tests asserting metrics round-trip with json.dump(..., allow_nan=false); include a zero-supply smoke test to validate sanitization; verify no empty households; assert correct length of convergence diffs.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke and full runs with deterministic seeds; include a scenario with zero production/supply to trigger edge cases; ensure visualization does not block in headless mode.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Correct adoption_curve_convergence calculation; validate convergence metrics on synthetic data; add checks that adoption_by_loc_series is updated exactly once per day.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report JSON compliance status explicitly; include before/after code snippets for critical fixes; confirm tests for non-finite metric values pass.
